_source: Core rules (trace, clearance, drill, ring, edge, layers) copied from kicad-mcp-pro 4.22.4 bundled dfm_profiles (2026-11-24); they are more conservative than PCBWay's absolute minimums (0.1 mm trace/space, 0.15 mm drill). Silkscreen, mask dam and hole-to-copper values were added 2026-11-24; see each profile's _sources. Check the fab's current capabilities page before relying on any of them. Order-form options, stencil thickness, aspect ratio and IPC-7525 sources re-checked against the live sites on 2026-11-24.

_sources.min_silk_text_height_mm: pcbway.com/capabilities.html Standard table: Minimum Character Height (Legend) 0.8mm
_sources.min_silk_line_width_mm: pcbway.com/capabilities.html Standard table: Minimum Character Width (Legend) 0.15mm
_sources.min_mask_dam_mm: pcbway.com/capabilities.html Advanced table row 23: 4 mil green, copper < 2 oz (Standard table has no value)
_sources.npth_to_copper_mm: ENGINEERING QUERY: https://www.pcbway.com/helpcenter/Engineering_Questions/the_spacing_from_hole_to_trace.html: NPTH to trace min 0.2 mm; NPTH_design_rule.html: copper cut back 0.2 mm
_sources.inner_hole_to_copper_mm: pcbway.com/capabilities.html Advanced table row 13: inner-layer isolation ring >= 7 mil for 4 layers
_sources.min_hole_to_hole_mm: pcbway.com/capabilities.html Advanced table row 10: component holes >= 16 mil (normal process)
_sources.min_via_hole_to_hole_mm: pcbway.com/capabilities.html Advanced table row 10: vias <= 0.45 mm >= 11 mil
_sources.pth_to_copper_mm: ENGINEERING QUERY: https://www.pcbway.com/helpcenter/Engineering_Questions/the_spacing_from_hole_to_trace.html: PTH to trace min 0.35 mm
_sources.inner_hole_to_copper_by_layers: pcbway.com/capabilities.html Advanced row 13 'Minimum isolation ring of Inner layer': distance between minimum hole in inner layer and circuit, 4L >= 7 mil, 6L >= 8, 8L >= 9, 10L+ >= 10
_sources.stencil_thickness_mm: pcbway.com/stencil.aspx (checked 2026-11-24): the stencil form defaults to 0.12 mm (options 0.08-0.3 mm); set this to the thickness you order
_sources.min_stencil_area_ratio: IPC-7525 stencil guideline (current revision IPC-7525C, Nov 2021): area ratio >= 0.66. The value is as cited by TI SLUA271C and JLCPCB's stencil-design article (IPC-7525B); IPC's own text is paywalled
_sources.min_stencil_aspect_ratio: IPC-7525 stencil guideline (current revision IPC-7525C, Nov 2021): aperture width / thickness >= 1.5. The value is as cited by TI SLUA271C and JLCPCB's stencil-design article; IPC's own text is paywalled
_sources.min_stencil_web_mm: ASSUMED: typical minimum web between laser-cut apertures
_sources.hole_to_edge_mm: ENGINEERING QUERY: https://www.pcbway.com/helpcenter/Engineering_Questions/the_spacing_requirement_from_hole_to_the_edge_of_board.html: >= 0.5 mm (1.0 mm on V-scored panels)
_sources.ring_margin_mm: HEURISTIC: warn when an annular ring is within this of the minimum (drill wander)
_sources.min_npth_mm: not published by PCBWay (0 = not checked)
_sources.silk_to_pad_mm: not published by PCBWay (0 = overlap only)
_sources.max_aspect_ratio: pcbway.com/capabilities.html row 6 'Thickness to diameter ratio' (checked 2026-11-24): <= 8 normal process, 8-10 medium/high difficulty; row 5: a 0.2 mm hole allows at most a 1.6 mm board
_sources.max_aspect_ratio_hard: pcbway.com/capabilities.html row 6: 'greater than 12' is listed under 'Unable to make'

_sources.min_trace_width_mm: jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities: 1 oz trace/space 0.10 mm (1-2 layer), 0.09 mm multilayer
_sources.min_drill_mm: jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities: drill 0.15-6.3 mm, preferred minimum 0.2 mm (standard profile uses the preferred 0.2)
_sources.min_annular_ring_mm: jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities: PTH ring absolute minimum 0.18 mm 2-layer, 0.15 mm multilayer (recommended 0.25 / 0.20)
_sources.ring_margin_mm: jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities: recommended ring minus minimum (0.25-0.18 = 0.07 2-layer; 0.20-0.15 = 0.05 multilayer)
_sources.copper_to_edge_mm: jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities: copper clearance from routed board edges >= 0.2 mm (V-cut 0.4 mm)
_sources.min_mask_dam_mm: jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities: solder mask bridge 0.10 mm green/red/yellow/blue/purple 1 oz (black/white 0.13, 2 oz 0.20)
_sources.pth_to_copper_mm: ASSUMED: JLCPCB publishes no plated-hole-to-copper value
_sources.hole_to_edge_mm: ASSUMED: JLCPCB gives no plain hole-to-edge value; PCBWay's 0.5 mm reused
_sources.min_plated_slot_mm: jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities: plated slot 0.5 mm 2-layer, 0.35 mm multilayer
_sources.min_npth_slot_mm: jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities: non-plated slot 1.0 mm (draw on GM1/GKO)
_sources.stencil_thickness_mm: ASSUMED: JLCPCB's standard stencil thicknesses are 0.10-0.20 mm at no extra cost, and its engineers pick one unless you choose (jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-stencil-manufacturing, checked 2026-11-24); set this to the thickness you order
_sources.min_stencil_area_ratio: IPC-7525 stencil guideline (current revision IPC-7525C, Nov 2021): area ratio >= 0.66. The value is as cited by TI SLUA271C and JLCPCB's stencil-design article (IPC-7525B); IPC's own text is paywalled
_sources.min_stencil_aspect_ratio: IPC-7525 stencil guideline (current revision IPC-7525C, Nov 2021): aperture width / thickness >= 1.5. The value is as cited by TI SLUA271C and JLCPCB's stencil-design article; IPC's own text is paywalled
_sources.min_stencil_web_mm: ASSUMED: typical minimum web between laser-cut apertures
_sources.max_aspect_ratio: JLCPCB blog 'via aspect ratio' (checked 2026-11-24): do not exceed 10:1 for plated through-holes; the capabilities page gives no ratio
_sources.max_aspect_ratio_hard: not published by JLCPCB (0 = not checked)
